api.PARENT_DEPARTMENT_NOT_FOUND: The selected parent department no longer exists. Please reload the page and choose again.
api.EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND: The selected employee no longer exists. Their record may have just been deleted — please reload the page and pick again.
api.DEPARTMENT_CYCLE: This department cannot be its own parent — that would create a cycle in the hierarchy.
api.DEPARTMENT_HAS_EMPLOYEES: This department still has employees assigned to it. Move them to another department first, or set this department to Inactive instead of deleting it.
api.DEPARTMENT_HAS_CHILDREN: This department still has child departments. Delete them or move them under another parent first.
api.DEPARTMENT_HAS_POSITIONS: This department still has positions attached to it. Delete those positions or move them to another department first.
api.POSITION_HAS_EMPLOYEES: Employees still hold this position. Move them to another position first, or set this position to Inactive instead of deleting it.
api.LEAVE_TYPE_IN_USE: This leave type is referenced by existing leave requests or balances. Set it to Inactive instead of deleting it.
api.INVALID_SALARY_RANGE: The minimum salary cannot be greater than the maximum salary.

api.EMPLOYEE_ALREADY_HAS_ACCOUNT: This employee already has a login account.
api.EMPLOYEE_NOT_DELETED: This record is not deleted, so there is nothing to restore.

api.CONTRACT_NOT_DELETABLE: Only draft contracts can be deleted.
api.AVATAR_INVALID_TYPE: The uploaded file is not a JPEG/PNG/WEBP image.
api.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The request payload is too large.
api.DEPENDENT_ALREADY_CLAIMED: This person is already claimed by another employee. A dependent can only be claimed by a single taxpayer.
api.DEPENDENT_REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is required when stopping a deduction.

contractTypes.fixedByLaw: Employment contract types are defined by the 2019 Labour Code, and each one carries different obligations for social insurance, probation length and termination notice. The system therefore does not allow adding, editing or deleting them. The seasonal contract was abolished by the 2019 code and is kept only so historical data stays readable.
